name: olympus
description: Olympus answers questions from your own mail, files and notes, with citations. The engine runs privately on your Mac; ChatGPT asks it through one secure connection.

interface.shortDescription: Ask your own mail and files
interface.longDescription: Olympus is a private knowledge engine that runs on your Mac. It indexes the sources you choose: Dropbox, Gmail and Google Drive, connected with accounts you already have, and sources such as X bookmarks, Readwise, Telegram and WhatsApp, set up on your Mac. It answers your questions in ChatGPT with citations. Your index stays on your Mac; ChatGPT reaches it through one secure connection you approve on the Mac. The Olympus dashboard in the ChatGPT sidebar shows what is connected, how far indexing has got and anything that needs you.
defaultPrompt: Ask Olympus what I decided about the budget last month.
Use Olympus to find what Sam sent me about the lease.
